title: B44 Elevator Repair
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.NATIONAL GUARD BUREAU.JFHQ USPFO KS.USPFO KS PROCUREMENT.W7M9 USPFO ACTIVITY KSANG 184
description_text: B44 Elevator Repair This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Subpart 12.202(b), as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are being requested, and a written solicitation will not be issued. Work shall consist of the repair of Building 44’s elevator. Furnish and install one new Bucher valve control board and install one new zero-point leveling device on the Bucher valve. Perform functions check upon completion of installations to ensure the unit is operating properly according to the SOW Period of Performance will be 60 days from date of award at Building 44, 52970 Jayhawk Drive, McConnell AFB, KS 67221. ATTACHMENTS: 1. Combined Synopsis Solicitation 2. Clauses 3. PWS 4. Wage Determination Provide all questions and offers to email: 184WG.MSG.CONTRACTING@us.af.mil
